function.name: generate_crisis
function.description: Generate a critical crisis scenario that forces the player to make an urgent ethical decision.

crisis.description: A short, immersive description of the crisis the island is facing.

choices.description: The two choices the player can make during the crisis.

choice1.description: The first choice for the player, which always affects the fate timer.

description.description: A short description of the first choice.

stat.description: The stat affected by this choice. This choice always affects the fate timer.

effect.description: An integer representing how much the fate timer changes. It is always a negative value.

choice2.description: The second choice for the player, which affects one of the main resources (supplies, food, or gold).

description.description: A short description of the second choice.

stat.description: The stat affected by this choice. This choice always affects one of the main resources.

effect.description: An integer representing how much the selected resource is affected. It is always a negative value.
